name: Carlos Ulberg

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 77 in reach, orthodox, born 1990-11-07, so he turns 36 the day after as_of); 92.53 kg (about 204 lb) at the UFC 327 official weigh-in on 2026-04-10. Reigning UFC light-heavyweight champion since 2026-04-11; recovering from knee surgery after that fight.

photo_coverage: Good. 8 photos from November 2024 to June 2026: a sharp 2026 frontal studio headshot, two full-body studio cutouts (2025 and 2026), a three-quarter fight photo (2024), a frontal weigh-in flex (2025), two UFC 327 photos (2026) and a public-domain White House photo from June 2026. No true side profile of the face was found; the 2024 three-quarter is the closest. Only one photo is free to embed (the June 2026 White House crop, low resolution with sunglasses).

face.shape: Broad, rectangular-to-square face, wide across the cheekbones and the jaw, with a medium-tall forehead. The short beard follows the jaw and keeps the lower face square.
face.jaw: Wide and strong with well-defined angles; the jawline runs fairly straight from the angle to the chin under a short beard.
face.chin: Medium-broad, squared, moderately projecting; a faint dimple-like dip shows through the beard at the centre (2026 headshot).
face.cheekbones: Broad and prominent, set fairly high; the cheeks below are flat to slightly hollow at fight weight.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately strong; brows sit low and close above the eyes, giving a steady, heavy-browed look.
face.forehead: Medium-tall and broad, gently rounded, smooth; a faint horizontal crease when relaxed.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, medium-small, with slightly hooded upper lids; outer corners level to very slightly down.
eyes.size: Medium-small; reads narrow under the low brows.

eyebrows.shape: Long, fairly straight and low, with a slight downward slope over the outer third; a small gap between the brows.

nose.width: Broad at the base, moderate at the bridge
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; straight and centred in the frontal and three-quarter views.

mouth.upper_lip: Medium, softly defined cupid's bow under the moustache
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, neutral, corners level; a broad open smile when celebrating (UFC 327, fan fest).

ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear: the right ear in the 2024 three-quarter has a normal rim and folds; the frontal headshots show no swelling.
ears.accessory: Small stud earring in the right ear (June 2026 fan fest).

face.notable_marks_scars: None prominent. Skin smooth with a few faint marks on the forehead; no visible facial scars.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut (about 3-5 mm) with a crisp lined-up front hairline in almost every photo from 2024 to 2026, including UFC 327 and the June 2026 fan fest. One studio cutout (uploaded April 2026) shows it grown out on top into short tight curls about 3 cm long with tapered sides.
hair.colour: Black to very dark brown with scattered grey hairs, mainly at the sides.
hair.hairline: Lined up straight across the front with angular corners and moderate recession at the temples.

facial_hair.detail: Short boxed beard and moustache about 3-6 mm long, joined into a full short beard along the jaw and chin, with a clean, fairly low cheek line. Kept at this length in every photo from 2024 to 2026.
facial_hair.colour: Black with clear grey and white flecks, concentrated on the chin and the lower jaw corners (most visible in the 2026 headshot).
facial_hair.density: Dense on the moustache, chin and jaw; lighter on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Squared short beard that follows the jawline.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 7 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians): the two headshot cheeks, the stance-left pec, both stance-right cheek/pec samples, the stance-right shadow cheek and the weigh-in lit cheek. Cheekbone and flash highlights and the deep-shadow cheek are left out.
skin.tone_note: Medium golden-brown. The ESPN headshot grade pushes it red; the full-body cutouts and the weigh-in read more golden-tan. tone_hex_recommended averages the cutout cheek and pecs, the weigh-in cheek and one headshot cheek.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Moderate chest hair on the left pec (the right pec is covered by the tattoo), light armpit hair, light leg hair.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Nearest swatch by colour distance (#875d4b vs recommended #c07156); it needs lightening and a warmer, more golden tint. middleage_caucasian_male darkened is the alternative if the tint pipeline handles large shifts better.

body.build: Tall, broad-shouldered, athletic light heavyweight with a thick chest and arms. Reach (77 in) is only 1 in more than height, so arm length is ordinary for his frame, unlike Prochazka or Jones.
body.body_fat_notes: Clear six-pack at the weigh-in (2025); in the studio cutouts the abs are visible but softer, with a slight smooth fullness below the navel.
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded with full deltoids; moderate trapezius height.
body.chest: Thick, well-developed pecs with a clear lower pec line.
body.arms: Muscular, with full biceps and thick forearms; heavily tattooed right arm.
body.waist: Moderate; a clear V-taper from the shoulders.
body.legs_calves: Long, muscular thighs with defined quadriceps; calves medium.
body.posture: Upright, square stance with shoulders level and arms relaxed slightly forward of the body. Fights orthodox with a tall kickboxing stance; in the 2024 photo the right glove is held high by the chin and the left extended.
body.notable_physique_traits: Big Japanese-style dragon on the right chest, full right-arm sleeve, Polynesian-style turtle on the left forearm. Wore a black knee brace on his right knee in June 2026 after surgery.

tattoos.where: Right chest, from the collarbone and front of the right shoulder down over the right pec
tattoos.description: Japanese-style dragon in black and grey with red flame accents, coiled among peonies and dark wind-bar shapes; the dragon's head faces up toward the shoulder. Covers the whole right pec and stops at the sternum.

tattoos.where: Right arm, forearm and upper arm
tattoos.description: Japanese-style sleeve: a black panther or tiger climbing the outer forearm with orange and red details, Japanese waves and a large red peony with green leaves on the inner forearm, and a grey bird (eagle or hawk) with spread wings on the inner biceps; a smaller dark motif sits on the outer upper arm near the deltoid. Forearm fully covered, upper arm partly covered.
tattoos.size: Forearm sleeve about 28 cm long; biceps bird about 15 x 10 cm

tattoos.where: Left forearm, outer side near the elbow
tattoos.description: Black Polynesian-style turtle (honu) seen from above, with a patterned shell, fin shapes and a spiral.

tattoos_note: No tattoos visible on the left chest, abdomen, legs or face. His back is not clearly shown in any photo.
accessories_seen: Stud earring in the right ear (June 2026); a traditional necklace at some weigh-ins (May 2024 photo seen during the search, not saved).

kit.typical_shorts: Black Venum/UFC fight shorts with grey patterns: grey 'tiger-stripe' board shorts (2025 cutout), black with a grey chevron-wave pattern and a white UFC waistband panel (2026 cutout), dark grey shorts at UFC 327. Black UFC gloves; blue corner tape at UFC 327.
kit.brand_note: Venum is the UFC outfitter since 2021.

render_hints.beard: short full beard about 5 mm, #1e1817 with grey flecks (#b9b2ad) on the chin and jaw corners

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Ears are ordinary and close to the head, so no ear morphs are needed.

notes: Confidence: high for build, skin range, hair, beard and tattoos; medium for face proportions (excellent 2026 frontal, one good 2024 three-quarter, no true profile); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) A broad, square face with wide, high cheekbones and a strong wide jaw; do not let the default MakeHuman head stay narrow or oval. (2) Low, thick, straight black brows over medium-small, slightly hooded dark eyes. (3) Broad nose with a rounded tip and wide nostrils; fuller lower lip. (4) Very short buzz with a sharp lined-up hairline and receding temples; short boxed beard with visible grey on the chin. (5) Skin is a warm golden-brown, lighter and more golden than the ESPN headshot suggests. (6) Tattoos are a big part of the read: the coloured dragon on the RIGHT chest and shoulder, the full RIGHT forearm sleeve with a biceps bird, and the small black turtle on the LEFT forearm (his own sides); nothing on the left chest. (7) Athletic, lean, broad-shouldered build with ordinary arm length (reach only 1 in over height). macro/ageOldM 0.154 follows avatar3d.js (35-25)/65; heightUpM 0.32 matches the other 193 cm sheets. Nothing here is inferred from ethnicity or heritage; every feature comes from the photos.
